method_note: Each point is the single OneMap address-search feature for the address Keppel DC REIT's Annual Report 2025 gives for the facility. The served WGS84 latitude/longitude was re-derived from the served SVY21 (EPSG:3414) X/Y with pyproj 3.7.1 (always_xy, EPSG:3414 -> EPSG:4326); differences are below 1e-8 m. A search for each postcode returned byte-identical single results. No geocoding beyond the official address search, no offsets and no rounding were applied.
